title: used to
en:
used to + infinitive — past habits and states that are not true now: I used to work as an accountant. (Now I don't.) We used to have paper forms.

Negative: didn't use to. Question: Did you use to…? (no -d after did).

For a single past action, use the Past Simple, not used to: I went to London in 2018.

For present habits, use usually + Present Simple (not use to).
ru: used to + глагол — раньше (привычка или состояние в прошлом, сейчас не так): I used to work… Отрицание — didn't use to, вопрос — Did you use to…? (без -d). Для одного действия в прошлом — Past Simple. В настоящем — usually.

boss.situation: Compare how your work used to be five years ago and how it is now.
samples: Five years ago I used to work as an accountant.
We used to keep all documents on paper.
We didn't use to have a risk register.
Did we use to test controls? Not really.
Now we usually do everything in the system.

qs.q: I ___ smoke, but I stopped two years ago.
Did you ___ live in Almaty?
We ___ have computers in the office in 1995.
She ___ to the gym every morning now.
Last year I ___ to London for a conference.
There ___ be a cinema here. Now it's a bank.
My boss ___ to be very strict, but now he's relaxed.
What did you use to ___ as a child?
“I used to go to Turkey in 2019” is correct for one trip.
qs.exp: One trip → I went to Turkey in 2019.

qs.q: “I used to work at night” means I don't work at night now.
I ___ (use to / be) shy, but now I love presentations.
a: used to be

qs.q: Did you ___ to work at weekends?
a: use

qs.q: We ___ (not / use to / have) a canteen.
a: didn't use to have
did not use to have

qs.q: He ___ to play football every Sunday when he was young.
a: used

qs.q: My grandparents used to ___ (live) in a village.
a: live

qs.q: These days I ___ (usually / start) work at eight.
a: usually start

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: i used to work as an accountant

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: did you use to live here

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: we did not use to have a risk register

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: there used to be a park here

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: she used to be very quiet

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: what did you use to do after school

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “I use to work in a bank. Now I work at the refinery.”
a: I used to work in a bank. Now I work at the refinery.

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “Did you used to live here?”
a: Did you use to live here?

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “I used to going to the gym.”
a: I used to go to the gym.

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “She didn't used to like coffee.”
a: She didn't use to like coffee.
She did not use to like coffee.

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “I use to get up at seven every day.”
a: I usually get up at seven every day.
I get up at seven every day.

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “In 2019 I used to visit Paris once.”
a: In 2019 I visited Paris once.
In 2019 I visited Paris.

qs.q: Раньше я работал бухгалтером.
a: I used to work as an accountant.

qs.q: Раньше у нас не было системы.
a: We didn't use to have a system.
We did not use to have a system.

qs.q: Ты раньше жил в Алматы?
a: Did you use to live in Almaty?

qs.q: Раньше здесь был кинотеатр.
a: There used to be a cinema here.

qs.q: Раньше мы хранили все документы на бумаге.
a: We used to keep all documents on paper.
We used to keep all the documents on paper.
We used to store all documents on paper.
We used to keep all our documents on paper.

qs.q: Мой начальник раньше был очень строгим.
a: My boss used to be very strict.
My manager used to be very strict.

qs.q: Сейчас я обычно начинаю работу в восемь.
a: Now I usually start work at eight.
I usually start work at eight now.
Now I usually start work at 8.
Now I usually start working at eight.

qs.q: Что ты делал в детстве по выходным?
a: What did you use to do at weekends as a child?
What did you use to do on weekends as a child?
What did you use to do at the weekend as a child?
What did you do at weekends as a child?
What did you do at weekends when you were a child?
What did you use to do at weekends when you were a child?
